text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin, having somehow seized 
victory in the Kikuka Sho through pure 
grit and determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, lingering on the failure of her 
conditioning and utterly exhausted in both 
mind and body, she vented her weakness—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She asked to take a short break from both 
racing and training.
